parsed.post: Experiment result: val_bpb 0.838753. Lowering MATRIX_LR and increasing ASPECT_RATIO showed promise. Now testing if decreasing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase step count helps the model converge better within the 5-minute constraint.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer updates within the fixed 5-minute training budget, aiming for better convergence.
